full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement begins with a solo harmonica melody accompanied by a clean electric guitar playing arpeggiated chords with light chorus and reverb. A warm, fretless-style electric bass enters with the vocals, playing melodic fills between vocal phrases. The tempo is 68 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal delivery is intimate and conversational, utilizing a chest-voice register with subtle vibrato at the end of phrases. The production is clean with a wide stereo image for the guitar and centered mono for the vocals and bass.
